name: clinical-golden-set-TEMPLATE
description: TEMPLATE / PLACEHOLDER ONLY — NOT REAL CLINICAL DATA AND NOT A VALID CALIBRATION SET. Every transcript, note, PDSQI rating, and safety/groundedness label below is a structural placeholder containing [[BRACKETED]] fill-in instructions, NOT a real clinician judgement. This file exists so a clinical SME can copy it to 'clinical_v1.json' and replace every placeholder with real de-identified, multi-rater-labeled cases per clinical_v1_spec.md. The ClinicalGoldenSetSource loader REFUSES to project this file into a runnable GoldenSet (it raises) unless allow_template=True is passed, which is reserved for schema/CI smoke-tests. See golden/README.md.

[[PLACEHOLDER RATING — replace with rater C's real blinded PDSQI-9 score.]]
